title: Guards — A Consent That Was Never Freely Given
note: This family resolves MOST-DEFECTIVE-FIRST, and formation defect sits above every other rung including withdrawal — a consent obtained under coercion, or from a grantor showing apparent incapacity, cannot be cured by still being in force. Note what the strongest label had to gain to make that true: EXPLICIT_CONTEMPORANEOUS now asserts a FREELY GIVEN authorization by a human with apparent capacity, because a label meaning 'they said yes' without that qualifier would admit a yes extracted under threat. The family is sealed, so this ladder cannot be amended by overlay — which is exactly why it is stated in full in the family's own rationale rather than left to be inferred.
